chose: A showcase cards essay is held to its source by a test: its folder keeps the source file byte for byte at the commit its stamp names (its git blob id recorded), and a covers.json maps every heading and bold bullet of that file to the cards that cover it; the test fails on a section no card covers, a copy that isn't the file at that commit, a source the stamp no longer names, and a mapped shot or section that is gone. Essays in paulgsc/testing are not checked this way.
options: a showcase coverage test, offline, over a pinned copy of the source
a covers field in every cut list, checked by render cards-check against pinned copies kept in paulgsc/testing
no check: the routine's session reads the source live and the stamp dates the cards
